mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_evaluate (goods_id, user_id, content, images) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{images})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.goods_id, e.user_id, e.content, e.images, e.create_time, e.update_time, e.deleted, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM goods_evaluate e JOIN `user` u ON u.id = e.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE e.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.create_time DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_evaluate WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND deleted = 0
